Installation guide

How to install your wallpaper

  1. 1. Measure

    Measure the widest and tallest points of the wall in inches and add the trimming allowance.

  2. 2. Prepare the wall

    Clean, dry and smooth. Let fresh paint cure fully (about 3 weeks) before installing.

  3. 3. Hang panel 1 straight

    Draw a plumb line and align the first panel to it — every other panel follows it.

  4. 4. Smooth from the centre

    Work out bubbles from the centre outward with a smoothing tool.

  5. 5. Trim the edges

    Check the pattern match, then trim at the ceiling, floor and corners with a sharp blade.

  6. 6. Care

    Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Removable panels peel off; test adhesion on painted walls first.

Full preparation notes
Measure the widest and tallest points of your wall in inches. Add the extra trimming allowance recommended for your project. Prepare a clean, dry, smooth wall and let fresh paint cure fully. Lay out panels in order; align the first panel carefully and smooth from the centre outward. Trim edges only after checking the alignment. Follow the supplied material-specific instructions. Flat Matte gives a smooth, low-reflection finish. Texture adds a tactile surface and visual depth. Removable and permanent adhesives have the same price; choose for your wall and intended duration. Test adhesion first—removable does not guarantee damage-free removal on every painted surface.

Prefer not to DIY? Add professional installation ($3 / sq ft) when you order.
